title: A revision is worked on one screen — its costing is in a Costing tab, changed in place

steps.do: On the quotation: "Revise (new rev)" → why "Client asked for two more engineers" → Create revision.
steps.expect: You land on "Edit — Q-… Rev 01" with every tab. Message: "… Its costing <number> Rev 01 was made from … Rev 00 as a draft — change it in the Costing tab here, then submit it for approval."
steps.observed: Landed on "Edit — Q-00001 Rev 01" with tabs Client & header · Offices · Sites · Commercials · Line items · Costing · Terms. Message: "Created revision 01 with 1 line(s) and 0 site(s) carried over. Edit it below. Its costing AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01 was made from AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 00 as a draft — change it in the Costing tab here, then submit it for approval."

steps.expect: The revision's costing number (… Rev 01), Draft, revenue / cost / margin, and its roles with quantity, unit, rate and amount.
steps.observed: Costing tab: "AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01 Draft revenue ₹7.73 L · cost ₹5.89 L · margin 23.8% ROLE QTY UNIT RATE AMOUNT Site Engineer 12 MANMONTH 64,378 7,72,538 ✎ Change the costing Opens over this screen — change roles, rates and margins, a…"
steps.note: The Unit column shows the stored code "MANMONTH" instead of the word "Man-month".

steps.expect: The costing opens OVER the quotation (no new page, no menu inside). Change a role's quantity to 18, or Negotiation %, and press Save — the box stays open on the costing with your change.
steps.observed: Opened over the quotation; Negotiation % and the role quantity 18 both saved with the box staying open.

steps.do: Submit the costing for approval inside the box, then close it (×).
steps.expect: Back on the quotation's Costing tab — which now shows the new figures and status. Nothing you typed on the quotation was lost.
steps.observed: Submitted inside the box (no message seen), closed with ×: the Costing tab now reads "AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01 Submitted for approval revenue ₹11.81 L · cost ₹8.83 L · margin 25.2% ROLE QTY UNIT RATE AMOUNT Site Engineer 18 MANMONTH 65,604 11,80,879 O…" (with the negotiation changed in step 3); the contact typed on the quotation ("Meera Patel") is still there.

steps.do: "⇣ Take the costing's prices into the line items".
steps.expect: A message: "N line(s) now carry the prices of costing … Press Save to keep them." The Line items tab opens with the roles, quantities and rates filled; lines that are not in the costing are left as they are.
steps.observed: Message: "1 line(s) now carry the prices of costing AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01. Press "Save" to keep them.". The Line items tab opened with Site Engineer 18 at ₹65604.38 (the costing's new rate). (No line outside the costing on this revision, so "left as they are" was not exercised.)

steps.expect: Saved; no "why the prices differ" note is needed — they are the costing's prices.
steps.observed: Saved ("Costing submitted for approval — 2 levels to pass, in order: Level 1 — Branch Manager (Test BranchMgr): ⏳ waiting — with them now; Level 2 — Marketing Manager (Test MktMgr) — signs last: after the levels before it. | Quote saved.") with no "why the prices differ" note asked; the line holds 18 at ₹65604.38.

steps.do: EDGE · A quotation whose costing is approved and not held by it.
steps.expect: The tab shows "Open the costing" (read-only in the box).
steps.observed: The Costing tab offers "Open the costing" (no change button); in the box the approved costing is read-only.

steps.do: EDGE · A revision raised by someone who does not work on costings.
steps.expect: The tab shows "✎ Make this revision's costing" — pressed by a colleague who does, it makes the copy and opens it in the box.
steps.observed: Every role on the test copy that may raise a revision also works on costings, so a revision raised by someone who does not cannot be produced with the standard users.
steps.reason: Needs a custom role (may revise quotations, may not work on costings) set up by the owner.
